content:
Apple TV has completely steered clear of the dating reality show genre that is all the rage. Although its newly announced series The Last Person on Earth is positioned as a "documentary series" rather than a "reality show," it is still the streamer's first dating show.

The Last Person on Earth features renowned couples therapist Esther Perel and has been hailed as an "innovative experiment."

Esther Perel is a famous couples therapist and a New York Times bestselling author who specialises in the field of relationships.

Perel is also the central figure in Apple TV's newly announced eight-episode dating documentary series The Last Person on Earth.

According to a press release: "In the series, seemingly mismatched couples are carefully matched by Perel and a team of matchmaking experts and therapists, before embarking on an adventure to one of the most romantic and remote destinations in the world."

It sounds a lot like a reality show, but without the baggage of reality show branding. I suspect Apple is hoping to give the dating series an air of prestige by labelling it a "documentary series."

The series has not yet announced a premiere date, but is expected to debut in 2027.

Speaking of which, Apple announced yesterday that it will adapt bestselling author Rebecca Yarros's new romance novel into a TV series. Clearly, the streamer is looking to break out of its current core genres of sci-fi, comedy and thriller and expand further.

Apple TV costs US$12.99 per month, and a discount is also available through the Apple One bundle.
